So with a waterwheel and solar panels you'd have your own source of electricity. You'd also keep fuel on reserve to power gas generators if you needed them.

You could build a ram pump so that you'd always have running water too. A ram pump operates on pressure and doesn't require electricity or anything. A ram pump is also very cheap and easy to build. You could easily rig up a system to heat the water as well.

Long story short, for around 50k you have land, shelter, electricity and hot running water for the rest of your life.

Now with a cow, a chicken coop and a giant garden you'd always have milk, butter, cheese, yogurt, eggs, poultry, vegetables, fruit, and you could also stock the pond with fish. Herbs and spices too.

Now you'll need a rototiller and a few other tools and machines for this, so let's just add another 10,000$ onto the total cost for tools and small machinery.

Now mind you everything could be done manually with hand tools if need be.

So 30k for the land, 20k for the RV, and 10k for tools and small machinery, plus another 5k for a snowmobile (depending on climate and location) and you're set.

For under 70,000$ CDN you could have 100 acres of land, a decent shelter, your own electricity and running hot water, and your own supply of milk, butter, cheese, yogurt, eggs, poultry, fish, fruits, vegetables, herbs and spices, wheat and bread and pasta too. For 70k you can basically live off grid and free for the rest of your life.

You'd still go to the grocery store and you'd rely on a cellular connection for Internet, so it's not like you'd be in total isolation. The thing is, if you really needed to you could live completely self sufficiently on your own land.
